title: Sr Staff Engineer, Physical Verification
description:
We are seeking an experienced Physical Verification (PV) Engineer to drive signoff verification and tapeout readiness for advanced ASIC/SoC designs. The candidate will be responsible for executing and debugging physical verification checks, driving violation closure, maintaining foundry-qualified verification flows, and ensuring block and full-chip layouts meet manufacturing requirements before tapeout. Key Responsibilities Perform and drive signoff Physical Verification for block- and chip-level designs. Execute and analyze DRC, LVS, ERC, Antenna, and Density checks using industry-standard signoff tools. Debug verification violations and provide actionable recommendations to Physical Design and Layout teams. Drive closure of signoff issues through effective tracking, prioritization, and cross-functional collaboration. Maintain and support foundry-qualified rule decks, runsets, and waiver management processes. Manage waiver tracking and ensure compliance with foundry guidelines and project signoff requirements. Coordinate verification re-runs following design changes and ECOs to identify regressions and maintain signoff quality. Work closely with Physical Design, Layout, Foundry/PDK, and Program teams to achieve tapeout milestones. Generate periodic signoff status reports, metrics, and violation summaries for project reviews. Prepare final signoff evidence including DRC/LVS-clean reports, waiver summaries, and residual risk assessments for tapeout reviews. Qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in Electronics Engineering or Electrical Engineering. 10-15 years of experience in Physical Verification, Physical Design, or Backend Implementation. Strong expertise in DRC, LVS, ERC, Antenna, and Density verification methodologies. Hands-on experience with Calibre, Pegasus, or equivalent physical verification tools. Good understanding of foundry signoff requirements, PDKs, and semiconductor manufacturing rules. Experience in debugging and resolving complex signoff violations at block and full-chip levels. Familiarity with GDSII/OASIS databases, netlists, and tapeout processes. Proficiency in Tcl, Python, Perl, or Shell scripting. Preferred Qualifications Experience with advanced technology nodes (7nm, 5nm, 3nm, and below). Knowledge of Physical Design, PDN, STA, and implementation flows. Experience supporting multiple successful SoC tapeouts. Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Why Join Us Join a high-impact team responsible for ensuring silicon manufacturability and signoff quality for next-generation SoCs. You will work closely with design, implementation, and foundry teams to drive successful tapeouts on cutting-edge process technologies.

description:
We are looking for an experienced Synthesis and Timing Constraints Engineer to join our ASIC/SoC Implementation team. In this role, you will lead timing constraint development and synthesis methodologies for complex SoC designs, working closely with Architecture, RTL Design, Physical Design, and STA teams to deliver high-quality implementations across advanced technology nodes. Key Responsibilities Define, develop, and maintain timing constraints (SDC) at IP, subsystem, and chip levels. Drive RTL synthesis and optimization using Synopsys Design Compiler and Fusion Compiler. Analyze and resolve timing, area, power, and implementation challenges to achieve design targets. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure robust design convergence throughout the implementation cycle. Develop and enhance methodologies, flows, and automation to improve productivity and design quality. Support timing closure activities and drive best practices for synthesis and constraint management. Debug and resolve synthesis and timing-related issues during project execution. Contribute to flow improvements for advanced-node ASIC/SoC development. Qualifications Bachelors or Masters degree in Electronics Engineering or Electrical Engineering. 10-15 years of experience in ASIC/SoC implementation. Expert knowledge of Synopsys Design Compiler and Fusion Compiler. Strong understanding of Static Timing Analysis (STA), timing closure, and SDC methodology. Hands-on scripting experience in Tcl and/or Python. Experience with advanced-node implementation flows. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills. Ability to work effectively with global cross-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience with low-power design methodologies and optimization techniques. Knowledge of Physical Design and signoff flows. Familiarity with hierarchical and full-chip implementation methodologies. Successful experience supporting complex SoC tapeouts. Why Join Us Be part of a high-performing implementation team working on next-generation semiconductor products. Youll have the opportunity to influence methodology, drive technical innovation, and contribute directly to successful tapeouts on cutting-edge process technologies.

title: Sr Manager, Software Development Engineering
description:
Job Summary At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, youll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Introduction to team: Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travellers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences. The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source. We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence. In this role, you will: Lead, coach, and develop one software engineering team responsible for designing, building, and operating robust, scalable, and secure Data Quality Platform services. Set technical direction for your team across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, incident management, and data health experiences. Lead and collaborate on complex, cross-organizational initiatives, making thoughtful resource, delivery, product, and architectural trade-offs to maximize strategic value. Partner closely with product managers, architects, program managers, data platform teams, and data domain owners to prioritize roadmaps, clarify requirements, and deliver measurable outcomes. Define and raise engineering standards for coding, testing, architecture, observability, security, continuous delivery, performance, and cost management. Ensure reliable operation of production systems through effective on-call strategies, incident management, root-cause analysis, capacity planning, and continuous improvement of service-level indicators and objectives. Safely integrate and operate machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying artificial intelligence and machine learning concepts to practical data platform workflows. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor s Degree or Equivalent Level; Technical Degree Preferred. 8+ years of relevant professional experience and 3+ years of people management experience. Proven track record of end-to-end ownership for complex software or data platform systems, including system design, application programming interface design, data modelling, implementation, and ongoing operations within a defined product or domain scope. Strong proficiency in core software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, testing, continuous integration and delivery, and building secure, reliable, and observable services. Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, analytics systems, or a closely related domain. Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, make data-driven trade-offs, and align cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-quality software at scale. Preferred Qualifications Experience leading a software engineering team within a large-scale, distributed technology environment, with accountability for team-level architecture, technical strategy, and delivery outcomes. Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including service decomposition, data modelling at scale, backward-compatible application programming interfaces, and integration with batch or streaming pipelines. Deep experience with production operations at scale, including site reliability engineering practices, capacity planning, performance optimization, and building systems for high availability and resilience. Demonstrated ability to drive architectural modernization, platform migration, or legacy system deprecation while maintaining strong delivery and operational outcomes. Experience with cloud-native data processing, workflow orchestration, data contracts, anomaly detection, machine-assisted software or data quality workflows, and observability platforms. Proven ability to build an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture and develop engineers through feedback, coaching, career planning, and meaningful technical opportunities. Accommodation requests Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request.

Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Manager – Quality with strong hands-on experience in IPQC / In-Process Quality Control within the automotive two-wheeler or EV industry . The role will be responsible for driving process quality, vehicle assembly quality, defect prevention, process audits, quality systems and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. Establish and monitor process quality standards, inspection criteria and control plans across manufacturing lines. Drive First Time Right (FTR), FPY, PPM, rejection, rework and defect reduction initiatives. Conduct regular process, product and layered process audits to identify quality gaps. Ensure adherence to SOPs, work instructions, control plans, inspection standards and process parameters . Monitor critical-to-quality characteristics and ensure effective poka-yoke / mistake-proofing implementation. Lead RCA and CAPA for internal, customer and field quality issues using 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and other quality tools . Drive containment and corrective actions for repeat defects and line-quality issues . Work closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, R&D, Supplier Quality and Service teams to resolve quality issues. Establish and monitor EOL testing and functional inspection for vehicle assembly. Ensure traceability of critical components and process parameters. Drive SPC, MSA, process capability (Cp/Cpk) and statistical quality improvement initiatives wherever applicable. Support new product development, pilot builds and process validation from a quality perspective. Review and improve PFMEA, Control Plans, Process Flow, Inspection Standards and SOPs . Drive supplier-related quality issues in coordination with SQE/Supplier Quality teams. Lead quality improvement projects, Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives . Prepare and review daily/weekly/monthly quality MIS and management dashboards. Develop and mentor the IPQC/Quality engineering team . Must-Have Experience 10–15 years of experience in Quality within the automotive / two-wheeler / EV manufacturing industry . Strong and demonstrated experience in IPQC / In-Process Quality Control . Experience in vehicle assembly quality is highly preferred. Strong exposure to process audits, product audits and line quality . Experience with RCA, 8D, CAPA, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto and problem-solving methodologies . Good knowledge of PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA and APQP . Experience in monitoring FTR/FPY, rejection, rework, PPM and customer/field complaints . Exposure to EOL testing / functional testing of vehicles. Preferred Experience in electric two-wheelers / EV manufacturing . Experience in a fast-paced OEM/start-up manufacturing environment . Engineering degree in Mechanical / Automobile / Production / Electrical / Electronics . Six Sigma / Quality certification will be an added advantage. Ideal Candidate Profile Two-wheeler OEM + 10–15 years Quality experience + strong IPQC ownership + Vehicle Assembly Quality + Process Audit + RCA/CAPA + PFMEA/Control Plan + EOL + team management.

description:
Senior Executive- Purchase Location- Dommasandra 
 Job Purpose To manage and execute the procurement of construction materials, consumables, equipment, and services required for real estate projects. The role will be responsible for vendor development, sourcing, negotiations, purchase order processing, cost optimization, and ensuring timely availability of materials at project sites while maintaining quality and commercial requirements. Key Responsibilities Handle end-to-end procurement activities for assigned real estate and construction projects. Source and procure construction materials such as cement, steel, aggregates, blocks, tiles, sanitaryware, plumbing materials, electrical materials, hardware, paints, waterproofing materials, and other project requirements. Understand material requirements, specifications, BOQs, purchase requisitions, and project schedules. Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers and vendors. Obtain and compare quotations from multiple vendors and prepare comparative statements. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, warranties, and other commercial terms with suppliers. Generate and process Purchase Orders in accordance with approved requirements and company policies. Coordinate with Project, Planning, QS, Stores, Finance, and Accounts teams to ensure timely procurement and delivery. Monitor purchase orders and follow up with vendors for timely delivery to project sites. Ensure materials are procured within approved budgets and commercial terms. Track material prices and market trends to identify cost-saving and value-engineering opportunities. Maintain an updated vendor database and evaluate vendor performance based on quality, cost, service, and delivery. Resolve issues related to material quality, quantity, delivery delays, billing, and vendor payments in coordination with relevant teams. Ensure procurement documentation, quotations, approvals, POs, invoices, and supporting records are properly maintained. Support rate contracts and annual procurement negotiations for frequently used materials. Coordinate with site teams to understand urgent and critical material requirements and ensure timely availability. Assist in developing alternate sources and suppliers to minimize procurement risks. Ensure compliance with organizational procurement policies, approval matrix, and commercial procedures. Prepare regular procurement reports covering purchase orders, pending deliveries, cost savings, vendor status, and material procurement. Key Skills & Competencies Strong knowledge of construction and real estate procurement . Good understanding of construction materials, specifications, and market rates. Strong vendor development and negotiation skills. Good commercial and analytical skills. Ability to evaluate quotations and prepare comparative statements. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel and procurement/ERP systems. Ability to manage multiple project requirements simultaneously. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Cost-conscious and result-oriented approach. Ability to work under pressure and meet project timelines. Educational Qualification Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain, Procurement, Commerce, or a related discipline . The role requires strong functional expertise in Windchill PDMLink, with a deep understanding of engineering change processes, configuration and release governance, product structures, and BOM management. The ideal candidate should be capable of understanding business requirements, translating them into functional specifications and Windchill solutions, and effectively bridging the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams.

 PLM & Windchill Process Consulting 
 Analyze existing PLM processes and identify opportunities for process improvement and standardization. Work with business stakeholders to understand engineering and product lifecycle requirements. Facilitate AS-IS and TO-BE process discussions/workshops. Design and recommend business processes aligned with Windchill capabilities. Translate business processes and requirements into clear functional specifications. Provide functional guidance on Windchill OOTB capabilities, configuration, and customization. Work closely with technical teams to ensure functional requirements are correctly understood and implemented. 
 Engineering Change & Release Management

Define and optimize configuration and release governance. Understand product revisions, versions, lifecycle states, and controlled product releases.  6 to 12 years of experience in PLM / Windchill programs. Strong experience as a PLM Process Consultant or Windchill Functional Consultant. Strong hands-on experience with PTC Windchill. Demonstrate capability gained over six to eight years of professional experience to operate independently in hybrid work models and to deliver consistent outcomes without requiring travel. title: Sr. Executive - Logistics
description:
Division: Marble Base Location: Bangalore Travel Requirement: Hyderabad and other client sites, as required Job Summary The Senior Executive - Logistics will manage the safe and timely delivery and unloading of marble at client sites. The role requires close coordination with transporters, clients operations teams, site supervisors and internal departments to ensure smooth unloading with minimal or no damage. Role Overview The candidate will be based in Bangalore but must travel to Hyderabad whenever required. Depending on site requirements, the candidate may need to stay in Hyderabad for up to 15 consecutive days. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with transporters, drivers, clients and internal teams to ensure vehicles reach client sites on time. Remain present at the client site until the entire consignment is safely unloaded, inspected and formally handed over. Ensure marble slabs and products are handled and unloaded safely, with minimal or no damage. Coordinate the availability of labour, cranes, forklifts and other unloading equipment at the site. Build and maintain strong relationships with the client s operations team, site supervisors, contractors and security personnel. Address client queries related to delivery, material quantity, documentation, damage or shortages. Manage last-minute operational issues such as vehicle delays, unloading restrictions, labour shortages, equipment unavailability and site-access challenges. Verify the material quantity and condition against the dispatch documents. Immediately report any shortage, breakage or damage and coordinate with the relevant teams for resolution. Obtain proper acknowledgement and Proof of Delivery after successful unloading. Provide timely updates to the management regarding vehicle movement, unloading progress, client concerns and delivery completion. Travel to Hyderabad and other client sites whenever required. Stay at the client location for extended periods, including up to 15 consecutive days, if operational requirements demand. Documentation Responsibilities The candidate will be responsible for maintaining and completing the following documentation: Tax invoice Delivery challan E-way bill Lorry Receipt/Goods Receipt (LR/GR) Packing list Purchase Order or Work Order reference Vehicle and driver details Gate entry and vehicle-entry documents Material unloading checklist Quantity and condition verification report Damage, breakage or shortage report, wherever applicable Site photographs before, during and after unloading Client acknowledgement Proof of Delivery (POD) Material handover note Transporter bills and supporting documents Daily delivery and unloading status report Candidate Requirements Graduate or diploma holder in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations or a related field. Relevant experience in logistics, site coordination or transportation. Experience in marble, natural stone, building materials or other fragile/heavy products will be preferred. Strong understanding of delivery, unloading and transportation documentation. Excellent communication, coordination and relationship-management skills. Ability to manage client queries and resolve last-minute site-related challenges. Willingness to travel frequently and stay outside the base location for extended periods. Ability to work independently and remain at the site until the complete unloading and handover process is finished. Strong problem-solving skills with a high level of ownership and attention to detail.

description:

The ideal candidate will focus on the physical and electrical hardware aspects of gimbal systems, ensuring reliability in harsh environmental conditions.  About Cyient Semiconductor Cyient Semiconductor is rapidly expanding its Analog Mixed Signal and Power Management Design teams and is looking for highly skilled Analog Layout professionals with strong experience in PMIC development and Non-FinFET process technologies . 
 If you are passionate about building high-performance Power Management ICs and have delivered successful tape-outs on mature process nodes, this is an excellent opportunity to work with leading global semiconductor customers on cutting-edge products. Position Summary 
 We are hiring Sr Engineers, Staff Engineers, and Technical Leads with strong expertise in Analog Layout Design for PMIC products across higher process nodes and BCD technologies. This role involves end-to-end ownership of custom analog layouts, close collaboration with design teams, and contribution to successful silicon execution.

Develop layout for PMIC building blocks including: LDOs Buck Converters Boost Converters Charge Pumps Bandgap References Comparators Current Mirrors Power Switches Oscillators Voltage References Perform layout optimization for area, matching, performance, reliability, and manufacturability. Implement advanced layout techniques: Common Centroid Interdigitation Symmetry Matching Shielding Guard Rings Latch-up Prevention Run and resolve: DRC LVS ERC PERC Antenna Checks EM/IR Analysis Collaborate with Analog Design, Verification, Reliability, and Foundry teams. Support tape-out activities and silicon debug when required. Lead layout reviews and mentor junior engineers (Staff Engineer / Technical Lead levels). 
 Mandatory Skills Technical Expertise 5+ years of experience in Analog Layout Design. Strong experience in PMIC Layout Development . Proven expertise in Non-FinFET / Mature Process Nodes : 28nm 40nm 55nm 65nm 90nm 110nm 130nm 180nm Layout Methodologies Device Matching Techniques Common Centroid Layout Interdigitated Structures Guard Ring Implementation ESD Aware Layout Latch-up Prevention High Voltage Layout Considerations Reliability and Yield Optimization EDA Tools Cadence Virtuoso XL Virtuoso Layout Suite Calibre DRC/LVS/ERC/PERC Parasitic Extraction Tools Preferred Skills Experience in BCD Technologies. Exposure to Automotive PMICs. Experience with High Voltage (HV) and Low Voltage (LV) devices. Knowledge of Foundry Technologies: TSMC TI BCD GlobalFoundries Tower Semiconductor UMC Technical Lead / Staff Engineer Expectations Lead complete block and top-level layout execution. Drive project planning and layout closure. Interface with customers and global stakeholders. Mentor junior team members and conduct layout reviews. Ensure adherence to design quality and tape-out schedules. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile Strong PMIC layout background with multiple successful tape-outs.

title: Barista
description:
Complete opening and closing duties including setting up necessary supplies and tools, cleaning all equipment and areas, locking doors, etc Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Input orders into cash register system and collect payment from customer. Take orders, record in MICROS system and prepare food and coffee beverages. Ensure that appliances (eg, coffee makers) are turned on/off at the appropriate times. Bus coffee cart areas and tables. Clean dishes, utensils, work areas, tables and equipment throughout the day. Obtain change required for expected business level. Count bank at end of shift, complete designated cashier reports, resolve any discrepancies, drop off receipts, and secure bank. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, and support team to reach common goals. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (eg, small print). Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (eg, to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
